payload.title: Harden the reader app shell: error and not-found routes, scoped newsroom CSS, per-brand theme alias, revalidate validation
payload.description:
app/ has no error.tsx, loading.tsx, not-found.tsx or global-error.tsx; server pages throw on bad config (lib/category-repository.ts:838) and six routes call notFound(), so readers get Next's default white page. app/globals.css is 10,347 lines with 969 .newsroom-*/.news-desk-* selectors imported by the root layout, so every public reader page and Markus pod downloads the CMS stylesheet. tsconfig.json:33-36 resolves papyrus-site-theme to app/dev-themes.css, which imports all three publication themes, so the reference build ships every tenant's CSS (packages/papyrus/src/with-papyrus.mjs:80 does it right for publication repos). lib/media-route-response.ts:44 proxies SVG same-origin with upstream content type and no CSP, and app/api/media/[...path]/route.ts:15-19 joins decoded segments without rejecting '..' or empty segments and has no body size cap. app/api/revalidate/route.ts:34 parses the body with no validation and purges all tags on every call; lib/revalidate-prewarm.ts:16 derives the prewarm origin from the Host header when PAPYRUS_PREWARM_ORIGIN is unset. components/newsroom-client-shell.tsx:5-8 serialises the dev seed password into the RSC payload whenever NODE_ENV is development (opt-out via PAPYRUS_DEV_SEED_SIGNIN=0). The newsroom searchParams type is copy-pasted in five route files and drifts.

Fix: add branded error/not-found/loading routes at root and under app/newsroom/; move newsroom CSS to a file imported from app/newsroom/layout.tsx; resolve the theme alias per PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND in next.config.ts; drop svg from the inline proxy set or add Content-Security-Policy: sandbox and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, reject '.', '..' and empty segments, cap body size; validate the revalidate body with Zod and purge global tags only when asked; require PAPYRUS_PREWARM_ORIGIN in production; make dev seed sign-in opt-in and never send the password; export one NewsDeskSearchParams type.

Done when: a public reader page downloads no .newsroom-* CSS, an uploaded SVG cannot execute script in the reader origin, and a bad revalidate body returns 400.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
